Name: See Me Rollin'
Author: Khloe Leclair
TagLine: See Me Rollin' gives your character roller shoes, letting you move faster when desired by holding a key.
Description:
See Me Rollin' gives your character roller shoes, letting you move faster when desired by holding a key.

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
How to use
Your character's speed is increased when you hold the hotkey, which defaults to Space. By default, you slowly lose speed over time, until your character kicks off with their other foot, giving you another burst of speed. You can configure how your speed changes, or make the change constant.

By default, you can use the speed boost while in your swimming costume but not when afflicted with a de-buff that slows your movement.

Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/Mac/Windows.

*   Works with [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) .

*   Works in single player and multiplayer. When playing in multiplayer, the animation of other farmers using their roller shoes may appear choppy as they appear to skip around.
